scope: WIOA Title I Adult, Dislocated Worker, and Youth programs and WIOA Title III Wagner-Peyser Employment Service, national state-reported performance

effectiveness_in_serving_employers.definition: Participants employed by the same employer in both the second and fourth quarters after exit; PY2024 is the first year of the newly defined indicator.

indicator_definitions.employment_second_quarter_after_exit: Percentage of exiters in unsubsidized employment during the second quarter after exit; the Youth indicator also counts participation in education or training.
indicator_definitions.employment_fourth_quarter_after_exit: Percentage of exiters in unsubsidized employment during the fourth quarter after exit; the Youth indicator also counts participation in education or training.
indicator_definitions.median_earnings_second_quarter_after_exi: Median earnings among participants in unsubsidized employment during the second quarter after exit.
indicator_definitions.credential_attainment_rate: Percentage of participants enrolled in education or training who attained a recognized postsecondary credential or secondary-school diploma or equivalent during participation or within one year after exit, subject to the statutory indicator conditions.
indicator_definitions.measurable_skill_gains_rate: Percentage of participants in an education or training program who achieved a documented academic, technical, occupational, or other qualifying gain during the program year.
indicator_definitions.denominator_note: Published rates use indicator-specific eligible exiters or participants and statutory exclusions; participants served and participants received training are not the denominators for every outcome rate.

source_reconciliation.selected_value_basis: The underlying official PY2024 Annual Summary Report PDF is used for the machine record; the conflicting results-at-a-glance webpage value is retained as an unresolved publisher discrepancy.

prohibited_inferences: Do not treat participants served as the denominator for every published performance rate.
Do not attribute outcomes causally to WIOA participation or federal spending without a counterfactual design.
Do not divide OMB subfunction 504 outlays by these participant or outcome values; the scopes and accounting boundaries are not crosswalked.
Do not infer waste, fraud, recoverable savings, or an expected spending level from this descriptive baseline.
